browser.placeholder: Type an address, or words to look up
browser.empty: Pages open here, beside the conversation, so you can look while you talk.
browser.blank: Page not showing? Some sites don’t allow being shown inside another one.
browser.own.title: {site} opens in a tab of its own
browser.own.text: Some sites can’t be shown beside the conversation: they don’t allow it, or your account only works in their own tab.
browser.install: Use it often? Install it as an app: it gets a window of its own and a place on your desktop, and works there as it should.
browser.install.chrome: In Chrome: open the site, then the ⋮ menu, Cast, save and share, and Install page as app.
browser.install.edge: In Edge: open the site, then the … menu, Apps, and Install this site as an app.
browser.install.safari: In Safari: open the site, then File, and Add to Dock.
browser.install.phone: On a phone: open the site, then Share or the menu, and Add to Home Screen.
browser.install.other: In your browser: open the site, then look in its menu for Install or Create shortcut.
browser.install.none: This browser can’t install sites as apps: keep the site in your bookmarks instead.
browser.build: {page} can’t show as it is: {file} has to be built first, with tools that don’t run in a browser. Ask for a page that runs as it is.
browser.shut: Your browser didn’t allow opening {folder}. Reload to ask again.
